title: What Is Cleanmax Anti-bacterial Technology?
bodyHtml:
Discover the CleanMax Difference

At Studio Bagno, we pride ourselves on combining timeless design with innovative technology to bring you the very best in bathroom fixtures.

One of the standout features of our ceramic toilets is the CleanMax technology, which is applied as standard across our entire range, ensuring every toilet is as hygienic as it is beautiful.

What is CleanMax Anti-Bacterial Glaze?

CleanMax is an advanced glaze applied during the firing process of our ceramic toilets. This innovative technology incorporates metal ions into a thin layer of glaze, which creates a permanent 'oligodynamic' effect on the toilet’s surface. This means that when bacteria come into contact with the CleanMax surface, they are unable to duplicate. As a result, your toilet remains more hygienic and fresher for longer.

Unlike other coatings that may wear off over time, CleanMax becomes an integral part of the ceramic, offering durable antibacterial protection that doesn’t fade or degrade, provided no harsh chemicals are applied to the surface that damage the glaze. The smooth, non-porous surface created by CleanMax also makes cleaning your toilet significantly easier, requiring only minimal effort to maintain a pristine appearance.

How does it work? The Science of Hygiene and Convenience

CleanMax works by utilizing the 'oligodynamic effect' most commonly seen in stainless steel cutlery - The steel creates a natural anti-bacterial effect on the surface of the cutlery. This is the same effect in use within the glaze of our toilets - CleanMax uses metal ions infused within the glaze to naturaly disrupt bacterial cells, preventing them from reproducing and spreading. This organic antibacterial action also reduces the risk of odors and stains, helping to keep your bathroom environment healthier.

Paired with the exceptional craftsmanship and designs Studio Bagno is known for, CleanMax is a hallmark of functionality meeting elegance.

Explore CleanMax Toilets

CleanMax is included as standard across all Studio Bagno toilets, ensuring every model provides a cleaner, more hygienic experience so whether you're designing a classic bathroom or a modern retreat, Studio Bagno’s toilets featuring CleanMax technology offer the perfect combination of hygiene, durability, and style.
